sections.heading: What We Collect
sections.body: MetroSafar collects profile details you provide, reward activity, support requests, limited device identifiers used to keep your in-app data separate, and foreground location only when you ask for nearby station suggestions.

sections.heading: How We Use Data
sections.body: We use personal data to maintain your profile, power rewards, respond to support requests, personalize station suggestions, and improve app reliability and safety. We do not sell your personal data.

sections.heading: Location Data
sections.body: Location is used only when you request nearby stations, directions, or route suggestions. Background location is not collected in this version of the app.

sections.heading: Retention and Security
sections.body: We retain data for service delivery, abuse prevention, and support history. Production service data is intended to be protected in transit and at rest using managed cloud infrastructure.

sections.heading: Your Choices
sections.body: You can update your profile, disable notifications, and request support for account or privacy concerns using the in-app support section.

sections.heading: Use of Service
sections.body: MetroSafar provides commuter information, nearby station discovery, rewards content, support access, and in-app games. Users must provide accurate information and use the app lawfully.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.body: Reward points, badges, and promotional benefits may be changed, paused, or withdrawn at our discretion. Fraudulent activity may result in forfeiture.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.body: We aim to keep MetroSafar available and accurate, but service interruptions, route changes, and partner limitations may occur.

sections.heading: Support and Escalation
sections.body: Users can contact support from within the app for rewards, account, privacy, and general app-related questions.

support.responseTime: Within 24 hours for in-app support requests

faqs.question: What can I do in this version of MetroSafar?
faqs.answer: This release focuses on nearby station discovery, rewards videos, commuter games, eco impact summaries, profile settings, and support information.

faqs.question: Do rewards expire?
faqs.answer: Rewards may expire according to campaign rules. Check the reward description before redeeming.

faqs.question: Why does the app ask for location?
faqs.answer: Location is used to suggest nearby stations and calculate directions when you request those features.

disclosures.title: Location Disclosure
disclosures.body: MetroSafar uses foreground location only when you request nearby stations or directions. No continuous background location collection is implemented.

disclosures.title: Notification Disclosure
disclosures.body: Notifications may be used for service updates, reward confirmations, and important account-related messages. Users should be able to disable them from device settings.

disclosures.title: Analytics Disclosure
disclosures.body: No analytics SDK is integrated in this codebase at present. If analytics is added later, the disclosure and privacy policy must be updated before release.

stories.description: The iconic gateway of Hyderabad, a symbol of culture and commerce

frames.title: Welcome to Charminar
frames.content: Charminar, built in 1591, is one of the most recognizable structures in India. It was constructed by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah, the fifth ruler of the Qutb Shahi dynasty.

frames.title: Architectural Marvel
frames.content: Standing at 56 meters tall, this Indo-Islamic monument features intricate latticed windows, arches, and minarets that showcase remarkable architectural craftsmanship.

frames.title: Cultural Hub
frames.content: Surrounding Charminar is the bustling market area where traditional crafts, textiles, and jewelry are sold. It remains the heart of old Hyderabad's commerce.

stories.description: A grand fortress showcasing the architectural brilliance of the Qutb Shahi era

frames.title: Golconda Fort
frames.content: Perched on a granite hill, Golconda Fort served as the capital of the Qutb Shahi dynasty. Its strategic location provided excellent defense and panoramic views of the city.

frames.title: Diamond Trade History
frames.content: Golconda was once the center of the global diamond trade. Famous diamonds like the Hope Diamond and Koh-i-Noor were sourced from mines near Golconda.

frames.title: Architecture & Acoustics
frames.content: The fort features amazing acoustic engineering. A handclap at one point can be heard at another distant location, demonstrating ancient Indian engineering brilliance.

stories.description: A serene water body offering respite and recreation for city residents

frames.title: Hussain Sagar Lake
frames.content: Created in 1562 by Ibrahim Quli Qutb Shah, this artificial lake is one of the oldest man-made lakes in India. It spans an area of 1,854 acres.

frames.title: The Buddha Statue
frames.content: A 16-meter tall granite Buddha statue stands on an island in the center of the lake. Inaugurated in 1992, it has become an iconic symbol of Hyderabad.

frames.title: Recreation & Conservation
frames.content: The lake is a popular spot for boating, walking, and nature watching. Recent conservation efforts have improved water quality and restored the ecosystem.
